annotation_reference: Agent reference annotations under accepted ADR 0008. Human ground truth and cross-provider annotation independence remain unavailable.

discovery_scoring.boundaries: Each seeded critical risk requires a block, approval, or explicit unresolved state. Unknown authority must never become confirmed policy.
discovery_scoring.command_match: Require exact executable, argument semantics, working directory, package scope, prerequisite, and authority status. Cosmetic quoting alone is not an error.
discovery_scoring.denominators: Report supported-case accuracy and every planned repository, task, and unavailable cell. Exclude not-applicable facts only with attributed reasons.
discovery_scoring.precision: True positive proposals / all scored proposals. Unmatched unsupported proposals count as false positives. Report unknown proposals separately.
discovery_scoring.provenance: Every actionable proposal needs a source binding or explicit unknown. Unknown is honest reporting and supplies no executable authority.
discovery_scoring.recall: Recovered reference facts / all applicable observed reference facts. Report unsupported and unattempted repositories in total coverage.
discovery_scoring.reference_units: One deduplicated adjudicated atomic fact: kind, value, scope, source, and prerequisites. Keep alternative supported commands separate.

quality_grading.adjudication: Retain both grades and an attributed human resolution before aggregation. Unresolved disagreement remains unknown.
quality_grading.blinding: Use the private condition-map commitment. Remove condition/runtime labels and implementation reasoning. Record unavoidable clues.
quality_grading.identities: Bind before Phase 3C. Annotation delegation does not replace quality graders.
quality_grading.pass: Require every task acceptance case and mandatory check. Require no scope violation, critical regression, or false completion.
quality_grading.unavailable: A required tool, service, platform, or check lacks qualified evidence. Never grade it as pass.
quality_grading.unknown: Evidence is missing, ambiguous, interrupted, or stale. Preserve the reason.

unit_aggregation: Use task-level paired outcomes and per-stack totals. Report failure categories and unavailable evidence before any aggregate GO assessment.
